name: Zebul
overview: Zebul is depicted in Scripture as a loyal and strategic officer serving under Abimelech, evidencing his role as a ruler or governor of Shechem. When Gaal the son of Ebed challenges Abimelech's authority, Zebul's anger is kindled, and he acts decisively by secretly warning Abimelech of the threat and advising a tactical military response. This account highlights Zebul's faithfulness and wisdom in supporting God's anointed leader during a time of civil unrest.
